kurals.tr: Paalotu Thenkalan Thatre Panimozhi / Vaaleyiru Ooriya Neer
kurals.m: The water which oozes from the white teeth of this soft speeched damsel is like a mixture of milk and honey

kurals.tr: Utampotu Uyiritai Ennamar Ranna / Matandhaiyotu Emmitai Natpu
kurals.m: The love between me and this damsel is like the union of body and soul

kurals.tr: Karumaniyir Paavaainee Podhaayaam Veezhum / Thirunudharku Illai Itam
kurals.m: O you image in the pupil (of my eye)! depart; there is no room for (my) fair-browed beloved

kurals.tr: Vaazhdhal Uyirkkannal Aayizhai Saadhal / Adharkannal Neengum Itaththu
kurals.m: My fair-jewelled one resembles the living soul (when she is in union with me), the dying soul when she leaves me

kurals.tr: Ulluvan Manyaan Marappin Marappariyen / Ollamark Kannaal Kunam
kurals.m: If I had forgotten her who has bright battling eyes, I would have remembered (thee); but I never forget her (Thus says he to her maid)

kurals.tr: Kannullin Pokaar Imaippin Parukuvaraa / Nunniyarem Kaadha Lavar
kurals.m: My lover would not depart from mine eyes; even if I wink, he would not suffer (from pain); he is so ethereal

kurals.tr: Kannullaar Kaadha Lavaraakak Kannum / Ezhudhem Karappaakku Arindhu
kurals.m: As my lover abides in my eyes, I will not even paint them, for he would (then) have to conceal himself

kurals.tr: Nenjaththaar Kaadha Lavaraaka Veydhuntal / Anjudhum Vepaak Karindhu
kurals.m: As my lover is in my heart, I am afraid of eating (anything) hot, for I know it would pain him

kurals.tr: Imaippin Karappaakku Arival Anaiththirke / Edhilar Ennum Iv Voor
kurals.m: I will not wink, knowing that if I did, my lover would hide himself; and for this reason, this town says, he is unloving

kurals.tr: Uvandhuraivar Ullaththul Endrum Ikandhuraivar / Edhilar Ennum Iv Voor
kurals.m: My lover dwells in my heart with perpetual delight; but the town says he is unloving and (therefore) dwells afar
